title: Difficult to Assemble
text: Difficult to Assemble. This product is one of the most difficult pieces I have assembled. And i’ve Purchased items from IKEA! It took two adults several hours. The last step was to insert a small shelf. Easy, right? Nope. The holes on the left didn’t match the holes on the right, not vertically or horizontally. So I guess that area will be for tall items...if I can think of any. Also, if you don’t screw it to the wall it isn’t stable.
